title.zh: Anthropic设立公共利益基金：初始承诺5%股份，公司估值上涨将自动追加
title.en: Anthropic设立公共利益基金：初始承诺5%股份，公司估值上涨将自动追加

current_state.zh: Anthropic launched an 'Anthropic Public Benefit Fund' seeded with 5% of company equity, structured to automatically grow by 2% per 50% valuation increase and explicitly barred from political lobbying or donations, part of a broader commitment putting roughly 20% of total shares toward public-interest causes including AI-driven labor disruption.
